article.title: How Data Quality Problems Distort Business Decisions

paragraphs.en: A dashboard can display impressive precision while relying on unreliable data. Imagine a retailer reporting a sudden increase in customer spending. Management celebrates the result and expands an expensive campaign. Later, analysts discover that the same transactions were imported twice after a system migration. The apparent growth was not a change in customer behavior; it was a processing error. This illustrates why data quality is a business risk rather than merely a technical inconvenience. Decisions about budgets, staffing, and customer communication can all be affected when measurements are wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 儀表板看似精確，資料卻可能不可靠。零售商看到消費額上升便擴大活動，後來才發現系統遷移造成交易重複匯入。成長並非顧客行為改變，而是處理錯誤。資料品質是商業風險，會影響預算、人力與客戶溝通。
paragraphs.ja: ダッシュボードが精密でも元データが正しいとは限りません。移行時に取引を二重取り込みすれば売上増加を誤認します。データ品質は技術だけでなく経営判断の問題です。

paragraphs.en: Data quality has several dimensions. Completeness asks whether expected records and fields are present. Accuracy asks whether values reflect reality. Uniqueness concerns duplicate records. Consistency examines whether the same concept is represented similarly across systems. Timeliness asks whether information is recent enough for the decision. Validity checks whether values follow defined rules, such as acceptable dates or category codes. A dataset can pass one dimension and fail another. For example, every transaction may have a date, but the date could refer to settlement rather than purchase.
paragraphs.zh: 資料品質包含完整性、準確性、唯一性、一致性、即時性及有效性。完整性看紀錄是否齊全，準確性看是否真實，唯一性查重複，一致性查跨系統定義，即時性看資料新舊，有效性查是否符合規則。每筆交易即使都有日期，也可能是入帳日而非購買日。
paragraphs.ja: 品質には完全性、正確性、一意性、一貫性、鮮度、妥当性があります。日付が存在しても購入日ではなく決済日かもしれません。

paragraphs.en: Definitions are often more dangerous than missing cells. Two departments may use the term active customer while counting different populations. One includes anyone who opened the app in the last month; another includes only customers who made a purchase. Combining these metrics without clarification creates false comparisons. Analysts should document the unit of observation, inclusion rules, time zone, event date, and aggregation method. They should also verify joins between datasets. A many-to-many join can multiply rows and inflate revenue even when the source tables contain no duplicates.
paragraphs.zh: 定義差異常比空值危險。兩部門的活躍客戶可能分別指開啟App和實際購買者。分析師應記錄觀察單位、納入規則、時區、事件日期與彙總方式，並檢查資料表連接。多對多 join 可能放大營收，即使原表沒有重複。
paragraphs.ja: 定義の不一致は欠損より危険なことがあります。アクティブ顧客が起動者か購入者かで数字は変わります。観測単位や集計方法を記録し、結合による件数増幅も確認します。

paragraphs.en: Freshness matters when decisions are time sensitive. A weekly customer list may be acceptable for long-term planning but unsuitable for preventing duplicate messages during a daily campaign. Late-arriving transactions can also change historical totals. Teams should distinguish the event time from the time a record became available, especially when building predictive models. Using information that would not have existed at prediction time creates data leakage and misleading performance estimates. A trustworthy evaluation reproduces what the system could actually have known when a decision was made.
paragraphs.zh: 資料新鮮度取決於用途。每週名單可能適合長期規劃，卻不適合每日避免重複發訊。延遲交易會改變歷史總額。預測模型應區分事件時間與資料可取得時間；使用預測當時不存在的資訊會造成洩漏與虛高表現。
paragraphs.ja: 鮮度の要件は用途次第です。予測モデルではイベント時刻と利用可能時刻を区別し、予測時点では存在しなかった情報の混入を防ぎます。

paragraphs.en: Quality checks should be connected to consequences. Instead of asking only whether null values exceed a generic threshold, ask which decisions depend on the affected field. Missing postal codes may be tolerable for an overall revenue report but critical for a geographic targeting campaign. A useful monitoring system checks record counts, duplicates, unexpected distributions, schema changes, and reconciliation against independent totals. When an alert fires, someone must own the investigation and decide whether the report should be paused, labeled provisional, or corrected. Automated checks are valuable only when they lead to appropriate action.
paragraphs.zh: 品質檢查應連結決策後果。郵遞區號缺漏對總營收報告可能可接受，對地區行銷卻嚴重。應檢查筆數、重複、分布、結構變化及獨立總額核對。警示發生時必須有人負責，決定暫停、標記暫定或修正。
paragraphs.ja: 品質検査は用途と結び付けます。郵便番号の欠損は全社売上には軽微でも地域施策には重大です。件数、重複、分布、スキーマ変更、照合を監視し、異常時の対応を決めます。

paragraphs.en: A mature data organization treats quality as a shared responsibility. Engineers maintain pipelines, analysts define metrics, and business owners explain how errors affect operations. Versioned definitions and reproducible tests reduce dependence on individual memory. When a problem is discovered, the team should record the cause, affected period, corrected results, and preventive action. Transparency is preferable to quietly replacing a number and hoping nobody notices. The goal is not a dataset with zero imperfections; it is a measurement system whose limitations are understood, monitored, and small enough for the decisions it supports.
paragraphs.zh: 成熟的資料組織把品質視為共同責任。工程師維護流程、分析師定義指標、業務解釋影響。版本化定義和可重現測試降低對個人記憶的依賴。問題發生時記錄原因、期間、修正結果及預防措施。透明說明比悄悄換數字更好；目標是能支援決策的可信衡量系統。
paragraphs.ja: 品質は技術者、分析者、業務責任者の共同責任です。定義の版管理と再現可能な検査を行い、原因、影響期間、修正結果、再発防止策を記録します。

paragraphs.en: A useful final safeguard is to publish a data quality note alongside important results. The note can state which source systems were used, when data was refreshed, which exclusions were applied, and whether known limitations might affect interpretation. If a number is preliminary, label it clearly rather than presenting it as final. Decision makers do not need every technical detail, but they should know what evidence is reliable and where caution is required. This practice makes uncertainty visible before it becomes a costly mistake.
paragraphs.zh: 最後一道防護是在重要結果旁提供資料品質註記，說明來源系統、更新時間、排除規則及已知限制。暫定數字應明確標示，而非當成最終結果。決策者不必知道所有技術細節，但應理解證據可靠程度與需謹慎之處，讓不確定性在造成昂貴錯誤前被看見。
paragraphs.ja: 重要な結果にはデータ品質の注記を添えます。出所、更新時刻、除外条件、既知の制約を明示し、暫定値は暫定と表示します。不確実性を判断前に共有することが重要です。
